#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int compute(const std::string& s) {
    int n = s.length();
    int p = (s[0] != '0') ? 1 : 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            p *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
        }
    }
    int p1 = 0;
    if (s[n - 1] == '_' && s[n - 2] == '_') {
        p1 = (n == 2) ? 3 : 4;
    } else if (s[n - 1] == '_') {
        if (std::string("0527").find(s[n - 2]) != std::string::npos) p1 = 1;
    } else if (s[n - 2] == '_') {
        if (s[n - 1] == '0') {
            p1 = (n == 2) ? 1 : 2;
        } else if (s[n - 1] == '5') {
            p1 = 2;
        }
    } else {
        int val = std::stoi(s.substr(n - 2));
        if (val % 25 == 0) p1 = 1;
    }
    return p * p1;
}

int main() {
    int T = 1;
    while (T-- > 0) {
        std::string s;
        std::cin >> s;
        if (s.length() == 1) {
            if (s == "0" || s == "_" || s == "X") {
                std::cout << 1 << std::endl;
            } else {
                std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
            }
        } else {
            bool hasX = false;
            for (char c : s) {
                if (c == 'X') {
                    hasX = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!hasX) {
                std::cout << compute(s) << std::endl;
            } else {
                int total = 0;
                for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
                    std::string replacedStr = s;
                    for (size_t i = 0; i < replacedStr.size(); i++) {
                        if (replacedStr[i] == 'X') {
                            replacedStr[i] = '0' + digit;
                        }
                    }
                    total += compute(replacedStr);
                }
                std::cout << total << std::endl;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
